text: “引导高质量的应用，促进消费升级，要探索跨行业、跨领域的合作，促进人工智能终端在智能制造、智慧教育、文旅、视听等领域的垂类示范作用。依托智能化分级等标准体系，加大对优质人工智能终端产品消费的补贴，引导、鼓励消费者采购人工智能终端优品、名品，提高公众的认知度和接受度。”7月17日，2026世界人工智能大会（WAIC2026）开幕，在“人工智能终端产业演进与协同发展”论坛上，全国政协委员、工业和信息化部原副部长王江平围绕“人工智能终端”提出上述建议，他认为，当前正是人工智能终端发展浪潮的一个关键的窗口期，业界人士应该要抓住机遇。（澎湃）
text_en: 'To guide high-quality applications and promote consumption upgrades, we should explore cross-industry and cross-sector cooperation, promoting the vertical demonstration role of AI terminals in areas such as intelligent manufacturing, smart education, cultural tourism, and audiovisual. Leveraging standard systems like intelligence grading, we should increase subsidies for high-quality AI terminal product consumption, guiding and encouraging consumers to purchase excellent and renowned AI terminal products, raising public awareness and acceptance.' On July 17, at the opening of the 2026 World AI Conference (WAIC 2026), Wang Jiangping, a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and former Vice Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, made the above suggestion at the 'AI Terminal Industry Evolution and Collaborative Development' forum. He believes the current period is a critical window for the wave of AI terminal development, and industry players should seize the opportunity. (The Paper)
